annotations.text:
Enrollment, rebuilt around the two things that actually go wrong.

1) THE TRANSCRIPT IS THE SILENT FAILURE. It gets concatenated ahead of your target text and is what aligns the reference; get it wrong and the voice quietly degrades with no error. So the app hands you a sentence to read instead of asking you to transcribe yourself. Free-form recording stays, one tap away.

2) VERIFICATION USED TO COST A FULL GENERATION. The spec asks for a test sentence right after enrolling — that is ~20 s on top of the recording. Screen 2 instead decodes the enrolled codes straight back through the vocoder: measured on the S26 Ultra at 2060 ms cold, ~0.5 s once the app is warm. And it is more diagnostic, because that IS the sound the model will use as its reference — clipping, over-trimming and bad levels are all audible in it.

The wait is the product, so it gets the instrument.

The eight bars are the model's real state: the un-masking loop penalises higher codebooks, so layer 0 resolves first and 7 last. The staircase is honest.

And the wait is no longer dead time — the composer stays reachable and lines queue up behind the one being made. That matters because short utterances cost roughly 2x per second of audio (the reference prefix is re-paid at every forward), so batching is both faster and what the UI should encourage.

Style is a PROFILE, not a setting.

Measured: a voice-design instruct is ignored whenever a clone prompt is present — every style landed within +-9 Hz of baseline F0.

But manner transfers through the recording (whisper: voiced 20.3% -> 24.1%). So 'whisper' is a second enrollment. Test / Re-record / Delete live on each card, per spec 6.

Three directions not taken, with their tradeoffs.

A INSTRUMENT is the real rival: opaque and high-contrast, so small Hangul and the numeric readout are easier to read, and it spends zero GPU — which matters when a warm device already runs ~2x slower. It just looks like a tool, and a product about voice has no voice on screen.

B QUIET UTILITY hides the machine behind a spinner, which cannot survive 20-80 s: no visible progress reads as broken.

C CONSOLE shows everything and stops being a product.

The shipped direction takes A's numbers and gives them a housing a non-engineer can read.
